channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Protests in Venezuela against US-Israeli war on Iran
item.description: Protesters in Venezuela have rallied outside the Iranian Embassy to condemn the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Nepal election: Is the monarchy still a force, two decades after ouster?
item.description: Ex-King Gyanendra Shah was removed from power 20 years ago. Will a Nepal in political flux give him another chance?

item.title: Is the US at war with Iran, and will it put boots on the ground?
item.description: Some of the main questions asked about the military developments in the Middle East, and what we know so far.

item.title: US senators fear ‘boots on the ground’ after Iran war briefing
item.description: Democratic senators voiced alarm after a classified briefing on the US‑Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: US Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify before Congress about Epstein ties
item.description: Lutnick's relationship with financier has come under scrutiny after files revealed closer ties than previously known.

item.title: Russia, China raise diplomatic voices against US-Israeli attacks on Iran
item.description: China's foreign minister tells Israel to end attacks; Russian FM Lavrov says no sign Tehran seeking nuclear bomb.

item.title: The Iran strikes could become a midterm reckoning – for Trump and Israel
item.description: Conservative dissent over the war is fracturing the GOP and testing the durability of US support for Israel.

item.title: South Korea’s stock market in meltdown amid US-Iran war
item.description: Benchmark index plummets as much as 12.2 percent, eclipsing single-day plunge after 9/11 attacks in 2001.

item.title: Israel, Iran continue attacks as war enters its fifth day, engulfs region
item.description: Iranian retaliatory strikes continue with drone and missile attacks as conflict spreads through Gulf nations.

item.title: Israeli forces bomb hotel in Beirut, residential building in Lebanon’s east
item.description: Israel hits Comfort Hotel in greater Beirut without warning; more residents displaced across Lebanon.
